name: code-embed-vscode
description: Local hybrid (semantic + lexical) code search for VS Code and AI agents

enumDescriptions: Inside the project (.code-embed/), or in the user cache when the project is on a risky file system (network drive, cloud sync).
Always in the user cache directory.

codeEmbed.index.maxFileKb.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are not indexed.

codeEmbed.index.threads.description: Number of threads for the local embedding model (0 = automatic).

codeEmbed.index.pauseOnBattery.description: Pause the vector phase of indexing while running on battery.

codeEmbed.model.id.description: Local embedding model from the built-in catalog (see "Code Embed: Select Model").

codeEmbed.model.offlineArchive.description: Path to an offline model archive to install from instead of downloading.

codeEmbed.providers.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible embedding providers: name → configuration. Do not put API keys here; use `api_key_env` or the "Code Embed: Select Embedding Provider" command.

base_url.description: Base URL of the API, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key.

codeEmbed.embedding.provider.description: Embedding provider: "local" (built-in model) or the name of a provider from codeEmbed.providers.

languageModelTools.name: code-embed_search
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the workspace code by meaning and keywords.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Hybrid (semantic + lexical) search over a local index of the current workspace's code. Use it instead of grep/ripgrep when searching by meaning: questions like "where is X handled" or "how does Y work", finding the implementation of a concept or behavior when you do not know the exact identifiers, natural-language queries in any language (including Russian), or when grep returns nothing or too much noise. Do NOT use it for an exact identifier, string literal, error message or file name, or to list every usage of a symbol: use grep/ripgrep or file search for exact matches. Returns ranked code chunks (path, line range, symbol, snippet); read the referenced lines for full context. Narrow the search with include/exclude globs and lang when you know where to look.

query.description: What to look for, in natural language or keywords, e.g. "where is the payment refund processed" or "retry with exponential backoff". Any language, including Russian.

mode.description: hybrid (default) combines meaning and keywords; semantic matches by meaning only; lexical matches keywords and identifiers only.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50).

include.description: Glob patterns relative to the workspace root; only matching files are searched, e.g. ["src/**"].

exclude.description: Glob patterns relative to the workspace root to skip, e.g. ["**/*.test.ts"].

lang.description: Restrict results to one language id, e.g. typescript, python, go, rust, markdown.

languageModelTools.name: code-embed_find_similar
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find code similar to a fragment or a range of lines.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find code in the current workspace that is semantically similar to a given fragment: duplicates, near-copies, alternative implementations of the same logic, other places that follow the same pattern. Pass either a location (path relative to the workspace root, start_line and end_line, 1-based inclusive) or a code snippet (code, optional lang). Use it before a refactoring or a bug fix to find other places that need the same change. Do NOT use it to find references, callers or usages of a symbol: use grep/ripgrep or the language server for that. Returns ranked code chunks (path, line range, symbol, snippet).

path.description: File path relative to the workspace root (use together with start_line and end_line).

start_line.description: First line of the fragment, 1-based, inclusive.

end_line.description: Last line of the fragment, 1-based, inclusive.

code.description: Code fragment to compare against (use instead of path/start_line/end_line).

lang.description: Language id of `code`, e.g. typescript, python. Only with `code`.

top.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-50).
